touches.text: The verdict's instrument run is a seal-grade run, so it runs where the sealer runs (9.4.2.3.3.1), under bubblewrap. A box without bubblewrap (Windows) asks for it and does not run it itself. A bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box, never red; its outcome is the sealer's. - CC
The chart chain machines (9.3.2): orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate, verdict.

conflicts.ticket_says: The chart's validate door refuses a criterion whose instrument does not extract to a command the sealer can start. Extract_command returns None for path heads with git index mode 100644, so validate refuses them on any box (including Windows), and no runner calls are made.
conflicts.why: Outline 9.4.8.1 states: 'A box without bubblewrap (Windows) asks for it and does not run it itself. A bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box, never red; its outcome is the sealer's.' This prescribes that Windows can draft and proceed with instruments it cannot run locally (delegating to the sealer). The ticket's logic refuses non-executable paths at validate time on any box, preventing Windows from drafting such instruments. The ticket makes validate reject unrunnable instruments everywhere; the outline prescribes Windows should be able to ask the sealer to run them.
